Criterion: Verify functionality of safety systems that provide protection against catastrophic failures prior to potential need of the safety system. Standard: Air vehicle safety systems are checked by built-in-test and/or their health is monitored to verify functionality prior to the safety systems being activated. Method of Compliance: A combination of engineering analysis, component, subsystem, and system testing verifies that critical safety systems are checked and their status is reported to the pilot/operator. References: JSSG-2000: 3.3.6 JSSG-2001: 3.3.7, 3.4.4.1.6 14 CFR 23.1301, 23.1309, 23.1351, 25.1301, 25.1309, 25.1351
